WITH dup_bills AS (
 SELECT vendor_invoice_no, COUNT(*) AS bill_count, COLLECT_SET(ap_doc_id) AS ap_doc_ids
 FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill
 GROUP BY vendor_invoice_no
 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
pay_counts AS (
 SELECT vendor_invoice_no, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
 FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_payment
 GROUP BY vendor_invoice_no
)
SELECT d.vendor_invoice_no, d.bill_count, d.ap_doc_ids, COALESCE(p.payment_count,0) AS payment_count
FROM dup_bills d
LEFT JOIN pay_counts p ON d.vendor_invoice_no = p.vendor_invoice_no
